headline: Janney Adds $3.5B Houston-Based Team From Raymond James
summary: Janney furthers its expansion into Texas by adding a team of Houston-based advisors departing Raymond James.

headline: Raymond James gets more bullish on Capri amid favorable setup
summary: Investing.com -- Raymond James has upgraded Capri Holdings to Strong Buy from Outperform, citing a low valuation bar, an expected solid quarter and room for long-term margin expansion.

headline: 1 Cash-Heavy Stock to Research Further and 2 We Find Risky
summary: Companies with more cash than debt can be financially resilient, but that doesn’t mean they’re all strong investments. Some lack leverage because they struggle to grow or generate consistent profits, making them unattractive borrowers.
